verdicts.working: The figure shows n-propylbenzene. Hot permanganate oxidizes an alkylbenzene side chain with a benzylic hydrogen to a carboxyl group, giving benzoic acid after acid workup.
issues: Acid workup is not stated; in the specified alkaline medium the product is benzoate, which would give benzoic acid upon acidification.

working:
Hot alkaline KMnO4 oxidizes an alkyl side chain bearing benzylic hydrogen completely to a carboxyl group. The propyl group -CH2CH2CH3 is converted to -COOH, regardless of chain length. Product: benzoic acid.

Independent check: The figure shows n-propylbenzene. Hot permanganate oxidizes an alkylbenzene side chain with a benzylic hydrogen to a carboxyl group, giving benzoic acid after acid workup.
solution:
Hot alkaline $KMnO_4$ oxidizes an alkylbenzene side chain containing a benzylic hydrogen completely to a carboxyl group, regardless of its length.
$$C_6H_5CH_2CH_2CH_3 \xrightarrow{hot\ alkaline\ KMnO_4} C_6H_5COOH$$
The product is benzoic acid.
